'''Dafir Toogan''' was a [[Technician|mechanic]] for resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[partisans]], attempting to maintain the [[starship]]s of the group's [[Cavern Angels]] [[squadron]] during Gerrera's [[Campaigns of Saw Gerrera's Partisans|campaigns]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]], Toogan was based out of the [[Catacombs of Cadera]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] and participated in an [[Battle on Jedha|ambush]] of [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit|Imperial forces]] by the partisans in [[Jedha City]]'s [[Tythoni Square]].

After the successful ambush, Toogan returned to the catacombs and was near the [[armory]] shortly before the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] Jedha City and sent a shockwave toward the partisan base. As the partisans attempted to escape the blast, Toogan ran out of the catacombs to one of the Cavern Angels' [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s.

==Biography==
[[File:DafirTythoniSquare-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Dafir Toogan took part in a partisan ambush in Tythoni Square.]]
Dafir Toogan was a [[Technician|mechanic]] who joined the resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[partisans]] during their [[Campaigns of Saw Gerrera's Partisans|campaigns]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. He attempted to maintain the chronically malfunctioning [[starship]]s of the group's [[Cavern Angels]] [[squadron]]<ref name="Dawn" /> and was with the partisans while they were based out of the [[Catacombs of Cadera]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]].<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> he was in [[Jedha City]] on the moon and passed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] in one of the [[city]]'s marketplaces, later standing with<ref name="RO" /> fellow partisan [[Casitine Loscar]]<ref name="Dawn" /> near Erso as she met the [[Guardians of the Whills|Guardian of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]] for the first [[time]].<ref name="RO" />

Toogan moved away when Erso did, crossing paths with her and Andor again as he leaned against an alleyway wall, standing to speak with a hooded individual as the duo passed by. Toogan was then among the partisan forces that [[Battle on Jedha|ambushed]] an Imperial [[convoy]] carrying [[kyber crystal]]s through [[Tythoni Square]]. After a [[grenade]] was thrown at the [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank]] carrying the [[crystal]]s, Toogan emerged and opened fire on the Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s in the square alongside a group of partisans that included<ref name="RO" /> [[Weeteef Cyu-Bee]].<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> Toogan then ran across the square as the [[TX-225 Occupier|tank]] fired on one of the buildings being used by the partisans. Once the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit|Imperials]] had all been [[Death|killed]], the partisans rushed forward to take the crystals and then fled as [[Jedha Imperial garrison|Imperial reinforcements]] arrived.<ref name="RO" />

[[File:DafirRunning-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|Toogan fled from the shockwave headed for the Catacombs of Cadera.]]
Erso and Andor were captured by the partisans and taken back to the catacombs soon after the ambush. Having also returned to the partisan base, Toogan stood near his comrade<ref name="RO" /> [[Beezer Fortuna]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> next to the partisans' [[armory]] as Erso was escorted past on her way to see Gerrera. The Empire soon fired the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] at Jedha City, [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroying]] it and creating a shockwave headed toward the catacombs. To try to escape the blast, the partisans rushed from the catacombs, with Toogan running to one of the Cavern Angels' [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s.<ref name="RO" /> Some of the partisans did manage to successfully escape the shockwave and survive, although others were killed by the blast.<ref name="SW39">[[Star Wars (2015) 39|''Star Wars'' (2015) 39]]</ref>

==Equipment==
Exposure to [[fuel]] and [[coolant]] chemicals required Toogan to wear a [[Color|black]] [[hermetic breath mask]], which he donned under the [[Clothing|hood]] of his brown [[robe]]s. He also wore a black device on his chest with a cylinder on either side and a brown [[belt]].<ref name="Dawn" /> In combat, Toogan fought with a [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="RO" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dafir-Promo.png|thumb|right|305px|Dafir Toogan was first revealed at Celebration Europe.]]
Dafir Toogan was created for the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="RO" /> which was released on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books|author=[[James Floyd|Floyd, James]]|date=2016-12-14}}</ref> Concept art including Toogan with a turban titled "Jedha Extras Silhouettes 1" was drawn for the film by costume concept artist [[Adam Brockbank]].<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release, the character was revealed as part of a reel of promotional footage for ''Rogue One'' shown at [[Celebration Europe (2016)|Celebration Europe]] on [[July 15]], 2016.<ref name="Celebration">{{SWYouTube|HUb_zpdyDpU|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story - Celebration Reel|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-celebration-reel}}</ref> Toogan was identified in the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="Dawn" /> within a section written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="DawnAuthor">{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}}</ref>
